title: General.
officialText:
Awnings, canopies, and sun control devices shall comply with the requirements of this section, the requirements of
Chapter 32 for projections over public ways, and other applicable sections of this code.
Exception: Canopies projecting over public rights-of-way governed by Title 19 of the Administrative Code and rules of the New York City Department of Transportation.
